:::{#def-supremum}
#### Supremum (least upper bound)

The **supremum** of a nonempty set $A \subseteq \mathbb{R}$,
written $\sup A$,
is the smallest real number $M$ satisfying $M \ge a$ for all $a \in A$:

$$\sup A \eqdef \min_{t \in \reals}\cb{t : \all a \in A, a \le t}$$

If the supremum belongs to $A$, it equals the maximum: $\sup A = \max A$.

:::
